description: Données géophysiques aéroportées is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ministère de la Transition écologique. As part of a three-year programme carried out by the Direction Générale de l’Aménagement du Logement et de la Nature with the assistance of the BRGM, an airborne geophysical survey campaign was conducted on the French Massif Central in 2022 and 2023. This campaign will also continue in 2024. Coverage: Ministère de la Transition écologique. The portal shows the English title as "Airborne geophysical data" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ministère de la Transition écologique. Its keywords include gamma-spectrometrie, magnetisme, geophysique, electromagnetisme. The listing shows 6 download or service links in ZIP, PDF. The listing shows 2026-01-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
